overview: The Medford Jazz Festival concluded its final night of performances at the West Medford Community Center. The evening featured jazz sets by the Dakota Lajow Trio and the Leo Blanco Trio, highlighting diverse cultural and regional influences on the genre.

items.title: Opening Remarks and Community Center History
items.summary: Terry Carter discussed the history of the West Medford Community Center as a historic African-American centerpiece and updated the mask policy for the evening.

items.title: Festival Sponsorship and Acknowledgments
items.summary: Jonathan Fagan recognized various sponsors including the Medford Arts Council, the Mystic River Watershed Association, and Patreon supporters.

items.title: Performance by Dakota and the Rest of Us
items.summary: The trio performed a set of jazz standards including works by Ronald Bright, Thelonious Monk, and Chick Corea.

items.title: Intermission and Refreshments
items.summary: Organizers announced a brief recess for audience members to visit the kitchen for refreshments.

items.title: Performance by the Leo Blanco Trio
items.summary: The trio performed original compositions exploring Arab, African, and South American influences on jazz, including tracks from the album Africa Latina.

items.title: Closing Remarks and Future Events
items.summary: Jonathan Fagan concluded the festival by encouraging newsletter signups for future jam sessions and thanking the community for their support.
